props:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG sprite atlas for an existing nature adventure game BIG LITTLE WORLD, featuring a tiny human exploring a giant garden. Reference image: the supplied environment-props sprite sheet is a STYLE REFERENCE only. Create a NEW matching collection, not an edit of those objects. High quality hand-painted fantasy naturalism, finely textured surfaces, defined readable silhouettes, rich moss greens, ochre and teal, luminous amber highlights from upper left; natural detailed game art with subtle painterly edge clusters, not flat vectors, not simplistic primitives, not photographic cutouts. Exact atlas layout: square canvas divided into THREE EQUAL COLUMNS and THREE EQUAL ROWS, NINE isolated props, ONE whole object centered inside each equal cell. Keep each object completely inside its cell with at least 10% empty transparent margins. Do not include grid lines, labels, numbers or any text. Completely transparent true alpha background, no checkerboard, no colored matte, no cast ground shadow. Consistent elevated three-quarter view around 30 degrees, coherent world scale.
ROW 1 left: a tall slim weathered garden lamp with a slender dark bronze pole and an enclosed warm glowing glass lantern, moss at base, full height visible. ROW 1 middle: a low horizontal old drainage pipe section with an open circular mouth facing lower right, oxidized metal and moss, clear dark interior, pipe fully visible. ROW 1 right: a cork-stoppered clear glass sample vial holding green pond water and a small aquatic leaf, bright glass highlights, no label.
ROW 2 left: a small stressed yellow wildflower plant with drooping pale ochre petals, dark center, detailed green stem and two wilted leaves, a few turquoise specks, no magic smoke. ROW 2 middle: a small wooden right-pointing trail sign on a short mossy stake, wood grain and twine, blank arrow surface, full stake visible. ROW 2 right: a single curled green leaf viewed from slightly above, with a compact neat cluster of tiny cream butterfly eggs on its upper surface, eggs clearly visible and anatomically plausible.
ROW 3 left: a large empty amber spiral snail shell, rich growth rings, curved dark opening visible toward lower right, tiny moss at lower edge, no living snail. ROW 3 middle: a low shallow oval piece of dark forest soil with delicate branching white mycelial threads entwined around small plant roots and tiny mushrooms, readable webbed texture, gently glowing pale turquoise tips, no circular solid backdrop. ROW 3 right: a tall slightly curved green climbing vine with a strong vertical stem, several small side leaves and curled tendrils, full stem from root base to tip, suitable as a climbable stalk underneath leaf platforms.
fish: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG animation sprite sheet, EXACTLY four columns and one row, for a small freshwater fish in a nature adventure game. A SINGLE coherent fish design repeated in FOUR swimming keyframes left to right. Full body of an elegant small silver olive freshwater minnow with a warm amber stripe and translucent teal fins, no accessories. Fish faces LEFT, horizontal side view with a subtle view of the upper back; visible eye on left, forked tail on right. Carefully preserve head size, body proportions, palette and center of body across all four frames. Frames depict cyclic tail beat: tail bends up, straight through center, bends down, straight through center; pectoral and dorsal fins change subtly. Quality: beautifully detailed hand-painted naturalist fantasy game sprite, soft clustered painterly details, readable silhouette, delicate scale highlights, clear eye, upper-left warm light, cohesive with a mossy illustrated garden. Each identical-size cell contains ONE WHOLE fish, individually isolated in its own cell with at least 15% transparent margins on every side. Fish body occupies 70% of cell width. All four are exactly the same scale and orientation, no rotation. Wide horizontal composition 4:1. Genuine transparent background alpha, no ground, no water, no bubbles, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no border, no grid, no checkerboard. Do not crop any fins or tails. This is actual game animation art, not a concept collage.
dandelions: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a transparent PNG game sprite atlas of the three dandelion objects used in BIG LITTLE WORLD, a hand-painted fantasy nature exploration game. Match the supplied mossy garden prop illustration style: finely textured naturalist painterly art, rich greens, warm upper-left golden light, clear complete silhouettes. THREE EQUAL COLUMNS, ONE ROW, each containing ONE separate isolated object at its center with generous empty transparent margins, all tips and roots fully inside the cell. Exact subjects left to right: (1) a full-height green dandelion plant with one CLOSED YELLOW FLOWER BUD, a slender slightly curved vertical stem, realistic toothed basal rosette leaves, tiny soil roots at bottom; (2) the SAME plant at the SAME scale with the same stem and basal rosette, now with a large beautiful spherical white fluffy DANDELION SEED HEAD composed of many delicate radial pappus filaments, readable rounded silhouette, airy translucent edges; (3) one single isolated mature DANDELION SEED parachute with an arched umbrella of very fine white feathery fibers, slender long attachment stem, and a small warm brown seed dangling beneath. All plants upright, elevated frontal three-quarter game perspective. Intended logical dimensions: the two plants each 64x112 game units, the detached seed 32x44 units. Each subject must be separately cuttable, no overlap across cells, no ground plane and no cast shadows. Genuine transparent alpha background, no fake checkerboard, no text, labels, grid or watermarks, not flat vector or code shapes. Wide horizontal sheet around 3:1.
